currency.$comment: Set in the authoring mode (authoring.tsx), with the coins and notes: eur, usd, gbp or custom. Unknown: eur

currencySign.$comment: Set in the authoring mode; only for currency custom

currencyPosition.$comment: Set in the authoring mode; only for currency custom: before or after

hint.en: A hundredth of the main unit, as written after a number: øre, ct, ¢. Empty: none (only whole amounts).
hint.nl: Een honderdste van de hoofdeenheid, zoals het achter een getal staat: øre, ct, ¢. Leeg: geen (alleen hele bedragen).

minorUnit.$comment: Set in the authoring mode; only for currency custom

hint.en: Set in the authoring mode. Empty: the usual coins and notes of the currency.
hint.nl: In te stellen in de authoring-modus. Leeg: de gewone munten en biljetten van de munteenheid.

pieces.$comment: JSON, as the authoring mode writes it: [{ "value": 50, "kind": "coin", "color": "gold", "offered": true, "count": null }, …]. value in hundredths of the main unit (50 is 50 cent; also without a minor unit: 500 is 5 kr); kind coin or note; color copper, gold, silver, silverInGold, goldInSilver or #rrggbb; offered: the pupil can take it; count: how many, null for as many as needed. A field left out: the currency's default
